description: §15.11.1 (S458 F4) — a `bind` prop written inside a BLOCK-bodied arrow (`() => { n = 200 }`, a `.forEach(x => { n = n + x })` callback) writes the caller's bound cell, and a by-value prop read inside a block-bodied `.map(x => { return label + x })` is the caller's value (the arrow's own parameter `x` is not substituted). One instance: a component whose body declares `const`s cannot be instantiated twice (module-scope `const` redeclared) nor inside `<each>` (E-EACH-BODY-DECL-UNSUPPORTED) today — both pre-existing, the §66.15.1 per-instance-state carried divergence.
rationale: §15.11.1: 'Changes to the bindable prop inside the component SHALL propagate back to `@var` in the parent.' §15.10.1: props are substituted at every ExprNode position, 'Function/lambda return expressions' included, and 'A `lambda` parameter with the same name is in scope … the parameter shadows the prop.'
